in_hebrew.name: Epperson
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Epperson הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English words 'eppa' meaning horse and 'sweor' meaning soldier. This name was common among early English knights.

in_greek.name: Epperson
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Horse soldier
in_greek.long_meaning: Epperson είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Old English words 'eppa' meaning horse and 'sweor' meaning soldier. This name was common among early English knights.

in_latin.name: Epperson
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Horse soldier
in_latin.long_meaning: Epperson est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Old English words 'eppa' meaning horse and 'sweor' meaning soldier. This name was common among early English knights.
